verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for an API service like Morph, but the evidence pack documents no telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out control. The only privacy-related item is a community quote of a tier-based data-training policy, where free-tier code may be trained on and enterprise-tier code is not. That is an adjacent data-use policy tied to plan level, not a user-facing opt-out from telemetry, so it earns no credit.
